property_summary: For every input, the reference C.transfer never reverts and returns true; the mutant which requires _tos.length == 0 will revert (or cause different completion) for any non-empty _tos — so for any non-empty recipient list and a callee that succeeds, the reference completes successfully while the mutant fails.
change_summary: Invert the initial require to require that the list is empty, causing different completion behavior and returns depending on input length.
